exposure: Type of recombinant gonadotropin stimulation (r-hFSH vs r-hFSH:r-hLH)
Cumulus cell (CC) gene expression profiles (CAMK1D, EFNB2, SASH1, GOT1, SLC6A9, HAS2, PTGS2, HSPH1, VCAN, GSTA4, STC2)
cohort: The study included 113 ICSI patients stimulated with either r-hFSH or r-hFSH:r-hLH.
finding: Specific cumulus cell gene expression biomarkers (e.g., GOT1, HAS2, SASH1, PTGS2) were identified as strong predictors of live birth, with optimal biomarker panels differing based on the type of recombinant gonadotropin stimulation.
